description: Fix direct mention visibility (requirement #2) and connect profile 'Direct Message' menu to DM system for local users (requirement #4). The existing direct mention system (visibility: direct statuses) must continue working - the backend is unmodified and notifications flow correctly. The issue is that the /timelines/direct route now shows the new DM UI instead of the old direct timeline. Fix: keep a route for the old direct timeline so receivers can still view direct mentions. For the profile menu: when clicking 'Privately mention' on a LOCAL user, open/create a 1:1 DM room instead of composing a direct-visibility status. For REMOTE users, keep existing directCompose behavior.
steps: In app/javascript/mastodon/features/ui/index.jsx: Restore the old DirectTimeline at path '/timelines/direct' by splitting the combined route. Make '/conversations' and '/conversations/:roomId' use DirectMessages (new DM system). Make '/timelines/direct' use DirectTimeline (old direct timeline). This ensures receivers of old-style direct mentions can still see them at /timelines/direct.

In app/javascript/mastodon/components/account_header/menu.tsx: Import `createChatRoom` from '@/mastodon/actions/dm' and import `useHistory` (or use the router). Modify the 'direct' menu action: check if the target account is local (account.acct === account.username, meaning no '@' in acct). If LOCAL: dispatch createChatRoom({ account_ids: [account.id] }), then navigate to /conversations/<returned uuid>. If REMOTE: keep existing directCompose(account) behavior. Note: The menu uses the `getMenuItems` helper function pattern - the dispatch and router access need to be passed in.

Since menu.tsx uses a function-based menu items approach with `dispatch` already available, add a `history` parameter (or use window.location) to navigate after room creation. The createChatRoom action returns a promise with { id, uuid }. After creation, navigate to `/conversations/${data.uuid}`. If the 1:1 room already exists, the backend returns the existing room.
Add a navigation callback parameter to getMenuItems. In the AccountMenu component (which calls getMenuItems), get history from useHistory() and pass it to getMenuItems as a `navigate` function.
acceptance_criteria: /timelines/direct route shows the old DirectTimeline component (existing direct mention inbox)
/conversations and /conversations/:roomId routes show the new DM system
Clicking 'Privately mention' on a LOCAL user's profile opens/creates a 1:1 DM room and navigates to it
Clicking 'Privately mention' on a REMOTE user's profile still uses directCompose (opens compose with @mention and direct visibility)
TypeScript/JSX files have no new syntax errors
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/mastodon && npx tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.json 2>&1 | head -80 (check no new errors in modified files)
findings: TypeScript compilation passes cleanly with no errors. useHistory imported from react-router-dom consistent with other DM components. The createChatRoom dispatch pattern uses `as unknown as Promise<{ id: string; uuid: string }>` matching existing usage in new_chat_room_modal.tsx and room_settings_modal.tsx. Added .catch handler to createChatRoom dispatch that falls back to directCompose on error (network failure, 403 block, etc).
